description: This file defines an internal interface 'ICacheMetrics' in the Orleans.Caching.Internal namespace, which specifies properties for collecting cache metrics such as hit ratio, total requests, hits, misses, evictions, and updates.

methods.name: HitRatio
methods.description: Property that returns the ratio of cache hits to total requests.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Property that returns the total number of requests made to the cache.

methods.name: Hits
methods.description: Property that returns the total number of cache hits.

methods.name: Misses
methods.description: Property that returns the total number of cache misses.

methods.name: Evicted
methods.description: Property that returns the total number of evicted cache items.

methods.name: Updated
methods.description: Property that returns the total number of updated cache items.
